channel.title: Moveworks incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Moveworks's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Assistant not responding in Microsoft Teams [resolved]
item.description: The intermittent unresponsiveness of the AI Assistant in Microsoft Teams has been resolved. Responses have returned to normal, and we have confirmed stability through continued monitoring. No further action is required from customers.

item.title: Custom AI Assistant Logo Reverting to Moveworks Default (Microsoft Teams) [monitoring]
item.description:
Microsoft's mitigation continues to roll out and we are monitoring propagation. Most users should see the correct custom logo restored.
If any users are still seeing the default Moveworks logo, please capture a HAR file while reproducing the issue and share it with Moveworks Support.
We will share additional updates as progress continues.

item.title: Issue Affecting Approval Requests [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: SharePoint Online Knowledge ingestion Authentication Issues [identified]
item.description:
We have identified authentication failures affecting SharePoint Online integrations that use Microsoft App Store authentication, following Microsoft’s deprecation of the legacy ACS authentication method. As a result, legacy SharePoint knowledge ingestion will fail for affected customers.
As an immediate workaround, please follow the SharePoint Online Azure App Registration guide.
https://docs.moveworks.com/service-management/access-requirements/knowledge-base-systems/sharepoint-online-access-requirements-new-1#1-configure-azure-app-registration
Engineering is working on a JWT-based update for Microsoft App Store authentication. We will share additional updates as they become available.

item.title: CSAT surveys not sent for the week of 7/28 [resolved]
item.description:
We identified an issue with CSAT surveys not going out for the mentioned week. We identified the issue and have fixed it; subsequent CSAT's should run as usual.
We sincerely apologise for the inconvenience caused.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.
